title: Ensemble review report
description: One reviewer's complete report on one artifact. Written to <run-dir>/<reviewer-id>.json and rendered to <reviewer-id>.md beside it. Reconciliation reads the JSON; the Markdown is for the human.

schema_version.description: Schema generation. Always "1" for this file.

reviewer_id.description: <lens>-<family>, with a -2 suffix when a panel seats the same pair twice.

lens.description: Persona name without the lens- prefix.

family.description: Resolved model family: claude, openai, google, xai, deepseek, ...

model.description: Concrete model id as dispatched. An audit record, not a configuration input.

leg.description: Which dispatch path produced this report.

artifact.description: Repo-relative path to the reviewed document, plus the revision it was read at when one is known.

artifact_revision.description: SHA-256 of the artifact bytes this seat actually read — the copy in the run's inputs/ directory. Null when the seat was dispatched against a working-tree path rather than a materialized one, which is how every report written before revisions existed reads. reconcile.py compares it to the manifest's and refuses on a mismatch; null is unpinned, warned about, and allowed through.

references.description: Repo-relative paths of the source-of-truth documents supplied to the reviewer.

reference_revisions.description: SHA-256 of each reference's materialized bytes, positionally aligned with `references`. Absent when the seat read working-tree paths.

verdict.description: The reviewer's overall ruling on the artifact.

summary.description: The verdict argued in prose, 600 characters or fewer.

method_notes.description: What the reviewer did and did not check; whether it verified anything outside the supplied documents.

findings.description: Every defect the reviewer raises. May be empty only when the verdict is ship.

_meta.description: Written by the dispatch script after validation, never by the reviewer: tier, usage, cost, timings, repair count. Operational state, not review content.

location.description: Section number, heading, or line range in the artifact.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the artifact, 300 characters or fewer. The clustering anchor when two reviewers cite the same text under different section numbers.

claim.description: One sentence stating the defect, normalized. The primary clustering key.

citation.description: The source-of-truth passage the artifact contradicts or omits. Required for any fidelity finding; null when the finding rests on the artifact alone.

severity.description: blocker: a builder or reader is led into a wrong outcome. should-fix: real defect, work can start around it. nice-to-have: improvement, not a defect.

reasoning.description: Why it is wrong, and what a builder or reader does wrong because of it.

suggested_change.description: The fix, written at the artifact's own altitude.

change_kind.description: literal-edit: the fix is an exact text substitution. judgment-call: the fix needs a decision a human must make. The auto-apply gate reads this field and nothing else.

literal_edit.description: Required when change_kind is literal-edit. old_text must occur exactly once in the artifact.

confidence.description: How sure the reviewer is that this finding is real.

externally_verified.description: Whether the reviewer checked a factual claim outside the supplied documents.

tags.description: Free strings used as clustering hints, e.g. wire-contract, threat-model.
